language.description: The ISO 639-1 language code for the Mnemosyne user interface.

data_directory.description: The root directory for Mnemosyne user data.

database_file.description: The filename of the SQLite database containing the cards.

auto_backup.description: Whether to automatically create backups of the database.

backup_interval_days.description: The number of days between automatic database backups.

card_font_size.description: The base font size for flashcard text in points.

theme.description: The name of the visual theme to use.

daily_new_card_limit.description: Maximum number of new cards to learn per day.

daily_review_limit.description: Maximum number of review cards per day.

allowed_extensions.description: List of allowed file extensions for media attachments.

max_media_size.description: Maximum size in bytes for imported media files (10MB).
